description: Third route to the zif-1 3'UTR: derive it from the Ensembl cDNA and CDS of transcript F59B2.6.1, then test for the MEX-5 U-rich element
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}

def seqtype(tid, t):
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.ensembl.org/sequence/id/{tid}", params={"type": t},
                     headers=H, timeout=90)
    return r.json().get("seq") if r.ok else None

tid = "F59B2.6.1"
cdna, cds = seqtype(tid, "cdna"), seqtype(tid, "cds")
print("cdna", len(cdna) if cdna else None, "cds", len(cds) if cds else None)
utr = None
if cdna and cds and cds in cdna:
    i = cdna.index(cds)
    utr = cdna[i+len(cds):].upper().replace("T", "U")
    print(f"derived 3'UTR length {len(utr)} nt (cDNA {len(cdna)}, CDS {len(cds)}, CDS starts at {i})")

def u_windows(s):
    return sorted({i+1 for w in range(9, 14) for i in range(len(s)-w+1) if s[i:i+w].count("U") >= 6})

if utr and len(utr) >= 20:
    starts = u_windows(utr)
    cov = len({j for i in starts for j in range(i, min(i+9, len(utr)+1))})
    print(f"U content {100*utr.count('U')/len(utr):.1f}%")
    print(f"MEX-5 minimal element (>=6 U in 9-13 nt): {len(starts)} distinct starts, covering "
          f"{100*cov/len(utr):.0f}% of the UTR")
    print("first matches:", [(i, utr[i-1:i+12]) for i in starts[:6]])
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0); arr = np.array(list(utr)); ctrl = []
    for _ in range(2000):
        rng.shuffle(arr); ctrl.append(len(u_windows("".join(arr))))
    ctrl = np.array(ctrl); p = float((ctrl >= len(starts)).mean())
    print(f"composition-matched shuffle n=2000: mean {ctrl.mean():.1f} sd {ctrl.std():.1f}, "
          f"observed {len(starts)}, empirical p = {p:.4f}")
    pd.DataFrame([{"transcript": tid, "utr3_len": len(utr), "U_fraction": utr.count("U")/len(utr),
                   "mex5_element_starts": len(starts), "shuffle_mean": float(ctrl.mean()),
                   "shuffle_sd": float(ctrl.std()), "empirical_p": p}]
                 ).to_csv("zif1_utr3_mex5_element.csv", index=False)
    with open("zif1_utr3.txt", "w") as f:
        f.write(f">{tid} 3UTR derived from Ensembl cdna minus cds, {len(utr)} nt\n{utr}\n")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 4.4))
    uu = np.array([1.0 if c == "U" else 0.0 for c in utr])
    sm = np.convolve(uu, np.ones(11)/11, mode="same")
    ax[0].plot(np.arange(1, len(utr)+1), sm, lw=1.1, color="#2b5d8c")
    ax[0].scatter(starts, [1.03]*len(starts), marker="|", s=90, color="#b03030")
    ax[0].axhline(6/11, ls="--", c="k", lw=0.8); ax[0].set_ylim(0, 1.12)
    ax[0].set_xlabel(f"position in the zif-1 3'UTR ({tid}, {len(utr)} nt)")
    ax[0].set_ylabel("U fraction, 11 nt window")
    ax[0].set_title("Red ticks: windows meeting the measured MEX-5 minimal element\n(6 or more U within 9-13 nt), dashed line is that threshold")
    ax[1].hist(ctrl, bins=25, color="#b9c4d2", edgecolor="w")
    ax[1].axvline(len(starts), color="#b03030", lw=2)
    ax[1].set_xlabel("element start positions per composition-matched shuffle")
    ax[1].set_ylabel(f"count of 2000 shuffles")
    ax[1].set_title(f"Observed {len(starts)} (red line), empirical p = {p:.3f}")
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
else:
    print("No annotated 3'UTR could be derived for zif-1 from Ensembl; no U-richness result is reported.")
